title: Network Effect
author: Martha Wells
summary: The first full-length Murderbot novel. The security android, known for avoiding humans and binge-watching shows, is dragged into an ambush with a familiar spaceship intelligence and a team of people it has grown to care about.
readIf: you've enjoyed the novellas and want a longer, more action-heavy Murderbot adventure.
skipIf: you haven't read the novellas, since the characters and history are assumed.

pairings.reason: Another funny, resourceful narrator solving life-or-death problems in space, with plenty of technical charm.
If the AI viewpoint is what you love, this is a denser, political space opera about machine identity.
A quick, witty military sci-fi with a narrator whose voice and body are not what they were.
